description.text:
This is the **merged full-weights** version of the v46 GRPO ESI triage adapter.

The LoRA adapter weights from [`vadimbelsky/qwen3.5-esi-triage-grpo-v46`](https://huggingface.co/vadimbelsky/qwen3.5-esi-triage-grpo-v46) have been merged directly into the Qwen3.5-9B base model used during training. This guarantees the model produces v46's exact trained output format (`EXTRACTION:` → `ESI ALGORITHM:` → `ANSWER: ESI N`) without the format drift seen when mounting the LoRA on a different base.

serving.text_only_input_quote: A 67-year-old male arrived via ambulance with sudden onset chest pain radiating to the left arm, diaphoresis, and shortness of breath. BP 88/60, HR 118, RR 24, SpO2 91%. History of MI and hypertension. Pain 9/10.
serving.system_prompt: You are an expert emergency triage nurse. Extract clinical fields, apply the ESI algorithm step by step, then state the ESI level. Be concise — stay under 150 words total.
serving.notes: generation_config.json sets eos_token_id 248044 and use_cache only. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja and is also in the model API. text_config.max_position_embeddings is 262144. config.json is Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration with a vision tower, but the card's example is a text note. Training max completion length was 512 tokens. Effective batch 8 is per_device 1 with grad_accum 8. Optimizer is adamw_8bit; the card does not say the base weights were quantized. The adapter card says the GRPO run warm-started from a v43 SFT adapter. Hub safetensors total is 9,409,813,744 BF16 parameters. adapter_config.json on the linked adapter repo has r 32, lora_alpha 32, and base_model_name_or_path models/Qwen3.5-9B. The adapter card says training scripts are in a project repository but gives no URL.

evaluation_reported.text: 77.8% exact accuracy / 94.4% adjacent accuracy on the 36-case MIETIC expert-annotated evaluation set.
